max_threshold_too_low.message: Maximum threshold ({value}) must be greater than minimum threshold ({min_value}).

user.title: Connection Mode
user.description:
Choose how to connect to your ESP devices.

• **Local Control**: Discover devices on your local network via mDNS (recommended for low latency)
• **Cloud Control**: Connect via ESP RainMaker cloud (works when devices are not on local network)

rainmaker_login.title: RainMaker Login
rainmaker_login.description:
Login to your ESP RainMaker account.

Enter your RainMaker credentials to access your cloud devices.

data_description.rainmaker_region: Select the RainMaker region where your devices are registered.
data_description.email: Your ESP RainMaker account email address.

cloud_action_select.title: Choose Action
cloud_action_select.description:
Select what you want to do:

• **Add Existing Device**: Add a device that's already registered in your RainMaker account
• **Provision New Device**: Configure a new device via BLE and add it to your account

ble_scan.title: Enter Device Name
ble_scan.description:
Power on your ESP device and check the serial log for a message like:

**Provisioning started with service name : PROV_XXXXXX**

Enter the device name (e.g., PROV_724d86) below.

wifi_config.title: WiFi Configuration
wifi_config.description:
Enter WiFi credentials for device "{device_name}".

The device will connect to this WiFi network after provisioning.

data_description.wifi_ssid: The name of the WiFi network to connect to.
data_description.wifi_password: The password for the WiFi network.
data_description.device_pop: Proof of Possession code if required by your device.

provisioning.title: Provisioning Device
provisioning.description:
Sending WiFi credentials to device and connecting to cloud...

This may take up to 2 minutes. Please wait.

cloud_device_select.title: Select Cloud Device
cloud_device_select.description:
Found {device_count} ESP RainMaker device(s). Select one to add.

Devices marked as 'Online' are currently connected to the cloud.

data_description.selected_device: Select the ESP RainMaker device to add.

data_description.custom_pop: Enter the PoP (Proof of Possession) code configured on your device.

device_setup.title: Select Device
device_setup.description:
Found {device_count} ESP device(s). Select one to add.

Device format: Name (IP) [Security]
• Open = No authentication required
• Protected = Requires authentication code

You can add additional devices later.

data_description.selected_device: Select the ESP device to add.
